app.name: PeopleForge
app.tagline: Increment requests and group-level employee data in one place.

home.heading: Welcome
home.intro: Submit and track increment requests, and give Sirius HR a single source of truth for employee data across all entities.
home.incrementPortalBody: Create requests, evidence the eligibility criteria and follow each request to a decision.
home.groupDashboardBody: Upload entity data, review anomalies and produce monthly, quarterly and annual reports.

states.errorBody: Please try again. If the problem continues, contact support with reference {reference}.
states.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist or you do not have access to it.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the information you entered is not valid.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.CONFLICT: This was changed by someone else. Refresh and try again.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file or data you sent is too large.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side.

hero.headline: Increments and employee data,
hero.description: Increment requests and group employee data for HR teams across Sirius and its subsidiaries.
hero.oneSignInText: Your organisation account. No separate HR password.
hero.secondCheckText: You confirm a code on each sign-in.
hero.roleAccessText: Subsidiary HR sees its own entities. Sirius HR sees all of them.
hero.notice: Every sign-in, successful or not, is recorded.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.subheading: Use the account your organisation gave you.
signIn.button: Sign in with your organisation account
signIn.note: For Sirius and subsidiary staff. You will continue on your organisation's sign-in page, such as Microsoft Entra ID.
signIn.unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Try again in a moment.

errors.noAccess: Your organisation account doesn't have access to PeopleForge. Ask your administrator to give you a PeopleForge role.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.fallback: We could not sign you in. Try again, or contact your administrator.

account.noPermissions: You are signed in, but your PeopleForge role doesn't include any permissions yet. Ask your administrator.
account.unavailableBody: We couldn't load your access details. Try again in a moment.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.intro: Every status change on your requests.
notifications.emptyBody: Status changes on your requests appear here.

reports.heading: Reports
reports.intro: Increment request reports for your subsidiaries, exportable to Excel and PDF.

request.employeesHint: Only {entity} employees can be added. Each employee can appear once.

request.noCycleBody: Sirius HR opens a cycle before increment requests can be raised.
request.noSubsidiaryBody: Ask your administrator to assign you to your subsidiary before raising requests.

errors.stale: This draft was changed in another window. Reload the page to see the latest version, then save again.
errors.duplicate: That employee is already in the request.
errors.employeeNotFound: That employee can't be added. They may have left or belong to another subsidiary.
errors.cycleNotOpen: That increment cycle is not open.
errors.rowsInvalid: Some proposals need a fix before the draft can be saved.
errors.notFound: This request no longer exists or isn't visible to you.
errors.generic: The change couldn't be saved. Try again.
errors.justificationTooLong: A justification can be at most 2,000 characters.
errors.notReady: Every employee needs a proposed increment and all criteria complete before you can submit.
errors.deadlinePassed: The submission deadline for this cycle has passed.
errors.notDraft: This request has already been submitted and can’t be changed.
errors.notPending: This employee was already decided or returned. Reload to see the latest.
errors.notInReview: This request is no longer in review.
errors.notReturned: Nothing is waiting to be resubmitted.
errors.decisionInvalid: Choose a reason and write a comment.
errors.percentRange: Enter a percentage above 0 and at most 100, with at most 2 decimals.
errors.notReadyResubmit: Every returned employee needs a proposed increment and all criteria complete before you can resubmit.

request.newIntroGeneric: Add employees, propose an increment, then complete the eligibility criteria for each one.
request.discarded: Draft discarded: it had no employees left.
request.criteriaHint: Pass or fail, a justification, and evidence where Sirius HR requires it. Criteria names come from Criteria settings.

decision.question: Sirius HR asks
decision.panelIntro: Decide this employee. The subsidiary is told straight away.
decision.approveHint: Approves the proposed increment unless you change it.
decision.commentPlaceholderReturn: What the subsidiary should answer or fix
